invariants.rationale: The method is expected to operate on a non-null list of data, as passing null would likely be an error.
Parallelism should be a positive integer for any parallel processing; non-positive values are likely invalid.
A list is either empty or has a positive size, reflecting standard List behavior.
It is common in parallel processing to have parallelism not exceed the number of items to process, though this may not be enforced.
List size is always non-negative by Java standard library guarantees.
